cases.narrative: Her teen mother gave birth in her bathtub and he took the baby under the pretense of giving her to someone for adoption and place her in a fallen tree in the woods, covering her naked body with snow. When she cried he said he fell on his knees, got emotional and left her there but did not tell cops he had shot her twice in the head.
